label: Agent Config
title: Agent Config
subtitle: Allows agents to inspect and modify agent settings — including enabling/disabling agents, changing their model, updating their system prompt, and adjusting temperature.
whenToUse: Used by orchestrator agents or automation workflows that need to dynamically reconfigure agents as part of a larger task. Most users will configure agents through the Settings UI instead.

methods.name: List Agents
methods.description: Returns all available agents with their current configurations.

methods.name: Get Agent
methods.description: Returns the configuration of a specific agent.

methods.name: Enable Agent
methods.description: Enables an agent so it appears in the sidebar.

methods.name: Disable Agent
methods.description: Disables an agent, hiding it from the sidebar.

methods.name: Update Model
methods.description: Changes the LLM model for an agent.

methods.name: Update Prompt
methods.description: Updates the system prompt for an agent.

methods.name: Update Temperature
methods.description: Adjusts the temperature parameter for an agent.

mediaCaption: An agent config update action card showing which agent was updated, the field changed, and the new value
